crewNotes.text: The crew-member duty-free limit for general goods is AUD450. General goods include gifts, souvenirs, cameras, electronics, leather goods, perfume concentrates, jewellery, watches and sporting equipment; the concession does not apply to commercial goods.

rules.text: A crew member aged 18 or over may bring 2.25 litres of alcoholic beverages into Australia duty free in accompanied baggage, regardless of where or how the beverages were purchased.

declarationRequirements.text: If a crew member exceeds a duty-free limit, duty and tax apply to all items of that type, not only the excess; the goods must be declared and proof of purchase provided.

disclaimer: Verify current requirements with the relevant authority and airline procedures before travel.
